rule: Strong candidates require detector score >= 0.9 and no reviewed ambiguity. All lower-scored or flagged candidates mask negative claims, rather than being treated as no cut.
provenance: Agent inspection of sampled before/peak/after sheets. Weak supervision only; exact cut-frame timing and recall remain unverified.

limitation: Score 0.9 does not guarantee a cut. Masks account only for detected or reviewed uncertainty. Training/test measures refer to this selective detector-defined task, not all human edits or fixture choices.
